title: Round 9: round 7's students with 16 times the training links, and competition that starts late
description: Round 7's DAgger gate3 students passed the gate as an ensemble with the veto (exp-net2-gate-r7e05-133, again on new episodes in exp-net2-gate-r7e05-s11-137) and matched the fixed rule on test, beating it with Cubic from the start (exp-net2-test-r7e-k0.5-134), but their competition gain shrank on test, and round 8, trained longer on the same 600 links, learned sharper beliefs in training yet did worse at the gate: the student generalizes poorly beyond its training data. Round 7 ran about 1,540 competition rollouts on 600 training links, about 2.6 per link, and its stock competitors always started at 0 s, while the evaluation's also start at 2, 4 and 10 s. Round 9 changes only the data. Arm links: the same learner on 9,600 training links of their own (examples/net1_broad.py set net2-train-xl, same distribution, new seed), so nearly every rollout runs on a link it has not seen. Arm broad: those links, and stock competitors that start at a uniform time in the first 10 s, with a second (Cubic, BBRv1 or Reno) half the time (PPOSpec competition "broad"); BBRv3 and Westwood stay held out. Everything else is round 7's: student gate3 trained from the rule with the cooperative teacher, teacher gain k = 0.5 or 1, threshold 0.5, learning rate 1e-3, 32 links of one rollout per iteration, a replay of 16 iterations, about one pass per iteration, 80% competition with Cubic, BBR or 2 or 4 copies, sigma = 0.05, seeds 1, 2 and 3, 60 iterations. Fixed before the run: each arm and teacher gain is gated as round 7e was, its three seeds as one policy on their mean beliefs with q vetoing the push, p's threshold at 0.5 and q's at 0 (four gates). Validation links only.
prepare: N="$IN/v5/net1-d0.05-w512-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: S="$OUT/spec-r9-$ARM-k$K-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg arm "$ARM" --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = "gate3" | .base = "fixed" | .share_k = $k | .gate_threshold = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20 | .competition = (if $arm == "broad" then "broad" else "at-start" end)' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r9-$ARM-k$K-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
